title: Crash when loading a specific scene in my project (signal 11)
body:
### Tested versions

- Discovered/Tested in 4.8.dev5 and 4.8.dev6
- Also happens on the newest commit of godot (57277407e77e61b161f35dbd7aeb510f7a9e26a6)

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev6 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 3 monitors (1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz, 1680x1050 @ 59.95 Hz, 1440x900 @ 59.89 Hz) - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1656) - AMD Ryzen 5 4500 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.79 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Whenever I open a specific scene in my project, there is chance (around 75% or so) that the editor completely crashes.
I use DebugDraw3D (1.7.3) in my project if that has anything to do with it.
I've removed every .gdextension (except DebugDraw3D) and disabled every plugin.
I also enabled Texture Streaming in my project, but I don't think it has something to do with it, due to the scene not having any streamable textures.
Upgrading Project files almost always causes it to crash.

I've tried building godot from source, in order to debug it, and this is the callstack:

Visual Studio says:
`Exception thrown: read access violation.
**this** was nullptr.
`

### Steps to reproduce

I have no clue what in the scene would cause that crash and therefor can't provide any reproducible steps.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Same as the steps to reproduce. I've tried making an MRP with some of the nodes in the scene that I think could be causing the crash, but the crash didn't occur there.
